answer.reason: Several verses tell events that happened at Jezreel, chiefly Jehu's killings of Joram, Jezebel and Ahab's house.

clauses.english: was where Jezebel was thrown down from a window and trodden underfoot
clauses.quote: Throw her down. So they threw her down

clauses.english: was where Jehu shot King Joram with an arrow, in Naboth's field
clauses.quote: smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart

clauses.english: was where Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab
clauses.quote: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel

doubts: HOS 1:4-5, 1:11 and 2:22 use Jezreel as a child's name and in prophecy, so I left them out.
The verses on the valley of Jezreel (JOS 17:16, JDG 6:33) may refer to the region rather than the town, so I left them out.
Naboth's vineyard (1KI 21) is left out because the verses given do not say where he was killed.
